headline: Shoriful's 4-wicket haul leads as Bangladesh avoid white-wash vs Zimbabwe
summary: Tanzid Hasan Tamim and Soumya Sarkar's record-breaking opening stand secures a seven-wicket win in the final ODI.
details: Bangladesh registered a consolation seven-wicket victory over Zimbabwe in the third and final ODI at the Harare Sports Club on Saturday.
Pacer Shoriful Islam dominated the first innings, claiming 4/44 to help bundle Zimbabwe out for 199 in 48.1 overs. Taskin Ahmed and Tanvir Islam each took two wickets.
In response, openers Tanzid Hasan Tamim and Soumya Sarkar shared a commanding 151-run partnership, the highest away opening stand for Bangladesh.
Soumya scored 69 off 82 balls, while Tanzid fell just short of a century, scoring 94 off 101 deliveries.
Bangladesh comfortably reached the target with 14 overs to spare, finishing the series on a positive note despite losing the first two matches.
The two teams will now move to Bulawayo for a three-match T20I series starting this Wednesday.
caption:
A record-breaking opening stand and a clinical bowling display! Bangladesh avoids the white-wash in Zimbabwe.

Bangladesh registered a consolation seven-wicket victory over Zimbabwe in the third and final ODI at the Harare Sports Club on Saturday.

Pacer Shoriful Islam dominated the first innings, claiming 4/44 to help bundle Zimbabwe out for 199 in 48.1 overs. Taskin Ahmed and Tanvir Islam each took two wickets.

In response, openers Tanzid Hasan Tamim and Soumya Sarkar shared a commanding 151-run partnership, the highest away opening stand for Bangladesh.

Soumya scored 69 off 82 balls, while Tanzid fell just short of a century, scoring 94 off 101 deliveries.

Bangladesh comfortably reached the target with 14 overs to spare, finishing the series on a positive note despite losing the first two matches.

The two teams will now move to Bulawayo for a three-match T20I series starting this Wednesday.

headline_marked: 5 killed as [[bus crashes into people collecting eggs]] in Faridpur
headline: 5 killed as bus crashes into people collecting eggs in Faridpur
summary: A speeding bus mowed down residents who had gathered to collect eggs from an overturned truck on the Dhaka-Khulna highway.
details: Five people were killed and at least seven others injured on Saturday evening when a speeding bus crashed into a group of people collecting eggs from an overturned truck in Faridpur.
The incident occurred around 6:30 PM in the Swadi bus stand area of Algi Union, Bhanga Upazila, on the Dhaka-Khulna highway.

A truck carrying eggs from Dhaka to Khulna overturned after a tire burst, causing the cargo to spill across the road. Local residents rushed to collect the eggs, at which point a Narail Express bus heading from Dhaka to Narail mowed them down.
The victims include the truck driver and four local residents. Three of the deceased have been identified as Joynal (27), Arif (27), and Obaidur (40).
Following the accident, angry locals set fire to at least six buses and trucks on the highway, blocking all vehicle movement.

Injured victims were sent to Bhanga, Faridpur, and Dhaka hospitals. According to the Bhanga Upazila Health and Family Planning Officer, five of the injured were transferred to Faridpur Medical College Hospital.
